name: Kejimkujik National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on the trails, inland and at the Seaside.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on the trails, inland and at the Seaside.

excerpts.quote: Dogs must be kept on leash.
For the safety of wildlife and other visitors, dogs must be on leash at all times.

dogRules.text: Dogs must be leashed on all trails; clean up after them.
St. Catherines River Beach closes for piping plover nesting; respect the closure.
No overnight stays at Kejimkujik Seaside.
Do daily tick checks on pets.
